description:
Save the current page as a PDF file.

The file is written inside the workspace directory (MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH, or the system temp directory when unset) — file_path must resolve inside that workspace. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is set to true.

file_path.description: Target file path for the PDF. Relative paths resolve inside the workspace directory; absolute paths must be inside it (e.g., "reports/page.pdf").

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at file_path. Default: false — existing files are refused. A directory at file_path is refused even with overwrite: true.

name: browser_pdf
